title: State owned India company REC issues first tokenized corporate bond
message_html: State owned India company REC issues first tokenized corporate bond ...
snippet: REC Limited, a state-owned lender to the power sector, has issued a ₹5 billion ($59 million) tokenized bond as part of a distributed ledger pilot and sandbox previously announced by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI).
